purpose: Teach: ウロウロ/かっこよく/光り/営む/釣る/働ける/チョン/リョウ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、駅前を、絶対、ウロウロ、絶対、してたよね
lines.en: Riku — you were definitely lurking around the station front today, weren't you?
lines.style: Teasing, caught-you energy. Quick rhythm. Slight laugh underneath. Playful accusation, not serious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前、本気で、絶対、今日、絶対、髪型、絶対、かっこよく、絶対、決まってるぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Your hair looks really cool today, Sakura — seriously.
lines.style: Genuine compliment delivered with a slight smile. Warm tone underneath cool exterior. Easy, not overthought.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨夜、本気で、絶対、月の、絶対、光り、絶対、輝いて、絶対、綺麗だったよね、リク
lines.en: Last night the moonlight was so beautiful, wasn't it, Riku?
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. Slow pace. Voice trails gently. A quiet moment of noticing something tender. Vulnerable.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、商店を、絶対、営む、絶対、人なんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Your grandfather — he's the kind of person who really runs a shop with care, isn't he?
lines.style: Thoughtful, respectful tone. Measured pace. Slight pause before the observation lands. Admiring something quiet.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、川で、絶対、お魚、絶対、釣る、絶対、のが、絶対、好きだよね、リク
lines.en: You really love fishing for fish in the river, don't you?
lines.style: Observant, gentle. Noticing something he cares about. No mockery. Soft rhythm. Like remembering something important about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 卒業したら、本気で、絶対、好きな仕事で、絶対、働ける、絶対、ように、絶対、頑張ろうぜ、桜
lines.en: After graduation, let's both work hard so we can do the jobs we actually love, okay Sakura?
lines.style: Earnest and steady. Light conviction in the voice. Looking ahead together. Not uncertain, but hopeful. Opening attack is resolute.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 歴史の授業で、本気で、絶対、チョン、絶対、髷、絶対、習ったよね、リク
lines.en: We learned about traditional topknot hairstyles in history class, remember, Riku?
lines.style: Reflective, remembering. Steady pace. Like bringing up something that stayed with her. Not urgent, just noting it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 転校生の、本気で、絶対、リョウ、絶対、君、絶対、面白いやつだぜ、桜
lines.en: That transfer student, Ryou — he's a funny guy, isn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Animated and bright. Quick energy. A small smile in the voice. Chatty, noticing someone new and sharing the observation.
